learning_plan_types.name: Hybrid Monthly Plan
learning_plan_types.tagline: Deep focus and mastery on a specific theme each week
learning_plan_types.description: Each week focuses on one main theme, culminating in a project related to the monthly theme

methodology.weeks_1_3: Learning progresses from foundation → exploration → application within the weekly theme
methodology.week_4: Project week where child applies everything learned in Weeks 1-3 into a detailed, theme-specific project
methodology.personalization: Learning adapts weekly based on child's profile, engagement, and past performance. Topics and difficulty can be adjusted automatically

strengths: Strong mastery and coherence within each theme
Clear goals for weekly learning and project outcomes
Parents can see measurable progress in a defined area
best_for: Children who benefit from structured depth learning
Topics that require cumulative understanding (STEM, complex projects)

learning_plan_types.name: Holistic Fusion Plan
learning_plan_types.tagline: Balanced exposure to multiple domains every week
learning_plan_types.description: Balanced exposure to multiple domains every week to ensure all-round growth

methodology.weeks_1_3: Randomized or dynamic topics across domains. Week 2 can have slightly more concentration in a specific area, but not exclusively
methodology.week_4: Project week where child synthesizes learning from previous weeks, combining key skills and knowledge, optionally adding small new concepts
methodology.personalization: Adapts dynamically based on child's interests, engagement, and performance while maintaining a balanced weekly routine

strengths: Broad exposure ensures all-round skill development
Dynamic and flexible learning keeps children engaged
Encourages multi-domain growth and synthesis in project week
best_for: Children who benefit from variety and balanced skill growth
Parents who prefer routine and consistent learning across multiple domains

weekly_structure.description: 4-week pedagogical framework used by both plan types
weekly_structure.framework: Based on Bloom's Taxonomy and 5E Model

weeks.goal: Build excitement and establish foundational knowledge
weeks.description: Introduce concepts in an exciting way that sparks curiosity and builds confidence

activity_types.main: 🎯 Discovery Mission - Explore through fun, hands-on activities
activity_types.secondary: 🌟 Wonder Wall - Create visual board of questions

weeks.success_metric: Child shows curiosity and asks questions

weeks.goal: Explore topics in depth with hands-on activities
weeks.description: Dive deeper into each topic with more complex activities and real-world applications

activity_types.main: 🔬 Deep Dive - Investigate through experiments and research

weeks.goal: Apply learned concepts to real-world scenarios
weeks.description: Practice and apply what you've learned through challenging but achievable activities

activity_types.main: 💡 Real-World Application - Use to solve everyday problems

weeks.success_metric: Child can explain concepts to others

weeks.goal: Create a comprehensive project showcasing all learned skills
weeks.description: Create something amazing that combines everything you've learned

activity_types.main: 🎨 Project Creation - Build components for masterpiece

project_metadata.project_outcome: A tangible creation that showcases learning
project_metadata.project_materials: Various materials based on topics covered
project_metadata.project_presentation: Family showcase at the end of the week

hybrid_monthly.personalization: Adaptive weekly based on profile & engagement

holistic_fusion.project_week: Combines previous weeks + minor new concepts
holistic_fusion.personalization: Adaptive weekly based on profile & engagement

key_points: Both plans are personalized, tracked, and progressive - core selling point
Hybrid = depth and clarity; Holistic = breadth and variety
Week 4 project in both plans ensures application and synthesis
Parents choose based on child's learning style: 'Depth-focused' vs 'Variety-focused'
